description: React component DevicesPage that manages and displays a list of devices, including creation and deletion functionalities. It interacts with external API functions and renders DeviceForm and DeviceList components.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the list of devices from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new device, including error handling and updating the device list.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of a device, with user confirmation, error handling, and list refresh.
